text: Mission promises each typed classifier is 'proven live'. No open bead takes a family whose bake-off wins into a host-tool surface and proves it both ways in a fresh omp rpc session. Cohorts .16/.17 are keyless offline adapters that are told not to enable enforcement. jev-grzn covers only the legacy surfaces listed today. The installer (.8/.22) leaves 'L4 organic behavior' as 'a separate live claim' that no bead owns. uzq1 accepts CODE (rule adapter or UPHILL), REFUTED or DROPPED for every family, and pillar 1 only checks 'claimed' surfaces. So stage 1 and the root can close with zero families live, and pillar 1 passes vacuously.
evidence: var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:170 jev-b35c.16 AC 'Do not require an unearned quality win or enable enforcement'; var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:171 jev-b35c.17 AC 'Enforcement stays off'; var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:286 jev-grzn description fixes the list (find, auto-thinking, smart stop, memory filter, web screen, injection screen, gate observe, skill hint, fleet watcher); var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:189 jev-b35c.8 description 'L4 organic behavior remains a separate live claim'; var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:533 jev-uzq1 verdict set LIVE|CODE|REFUTED|DROPPED with no minimum LIVE count; ROADMAP.md:24 lists .16/.17 as pillar-1 owners
fix: Add one 'promote family to live' bead per winning family, or one shared bead, depending on that family's RECEIPT. Its steps: wire the adapter into the named host hook through the installer, then produce a jev-grzn-style L3 receipt (positive plus planted negative in a fresh omp --mode=rpc session), then a jev-mvvh ledger row. Make uzq1 depend on these beads, and require at least one LIVE family or an explicit Joshua-approved zero-live verdict. Remove .16/.17 from the pillar-1 owners in ROADMAP.md:24.

text: The mission says the CLI 'makes the next one cheap'. No pillar, check, bead or acceptance measures what the next classifier costs to add: elapsed time, files touched, calls, or $ to go from decision spec to contract, fixtures, conformance, bake-off and adapter. The only related test is in jev-b35c.2: a registry entry shows up in capabilities 'with no other edit'. That is a code-plumbing assertion, not a cost measure. The 'adoption under an hour' check in r1vp/uzq1 times installing into a foreign repo, not adding family 17.
evidence: ROADMAP.md:9-10 mission text vs pillar table ROADMAP.md:22-29 (6 pillars, none about the marginal cost of a new classifier); .omp/mission.toml:6 identity has the same clause and no matching [[pillar]]; search for 'cheap|next family|new family|scaffold' over the 88 open beads finds only jev-b35c.2 AC ('adding a family to the registry makes it appear in capabilities and robot-docs with no other edit', var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:174)
fix: Add a pillar (or a stage-exit row) with a runnable check: 'classifier new <family>' scaffolds contract, fixtures, conformance row, PREREG skeleton and registry entry. A non-author then adds one real family (e.g. one of the DROPPED/pending ones) and records wall time, files edited and spend against a bar committed first. Make uzq1 depend on it.

text: 'Delivered through one model-neutral CLI' is not delivered for the surfaces that are actually live. The omp extensions call askJev/askJevChoice from kit/src/client.ts directly, with the backend hard-coded to Jev, and do not go through the classifier family registry or the --backend seam. No open bead cuts them over. jev-b35c.4 cuts over only the vendor shadow. So pillar 4's `--backend auto` routing and the doctor/ledger family view cannot reach memory, screen, gate or result decisions as they run live, and live receipts and CLI receipts describe two different code paths.
evidence: .omp/extensions/jev-memory-filter.ts:17 `import { askJev ... } from "../../kit/src/client.ts"`; .omp/extensions/jev-longres-shadow.ts:15 `import { askJevChoice } ...`; search over open beads: 'askJev' 0 hits, 'cutover' only in jev-b35c.4 ('vendor-shadow cutover to the single kit client', var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:185) and jev-b35c.14
fix: Add a cutover bead after .16/.17/.4. Every installed surface (memory filter, screens, gate observe, longres, skill hint, rerank) calls its family adapter through the registry and backend seam. A contract test fails if any .omp/extensions/*.ts or hook imports askJev directly. L3 receipts are re-run after the cutover.

text: Pillar 1's check is defined as `classifier doctor --json`: every claimed surface ON with an L3 receipt. jev-b35c.3, the doctor bead and the only pillar-1 bead in mission.toml, never reads or validates L3 receipts. Its detectors are key source, freshness, declared-OFF writes, switch files, schema, file modes and hook parse. jev-grzn writes work/l3-receipts/receipts.jsonl, but no bead makes doctor consume that file or turn RED on a surface that is ON without a receipt. As planned, the pillar-1 check cannot test its own clause.
evidence: ROADMAP.md:24 check column; .omp/mission.toml:24,27 (check doctor, beads only jev-b35c.3); var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:184 jev-b35c.3 description/AC: the JSON has no 'receipt' or 'L3' substring (checked: 'receipt' in json.dumps(bead).lower() -> False); var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:286 jev-grzn creates work/l3-receipts/receipts.jsonl and has no doctor integration
fix: Add to jev-b35c.3 (or a child) a doctor check: for each surface in work/jev-inventory/expected.json declared ON, require an ON-PROVEN row in work/l3-receipts/receipts.jsonl no older than N days, else RED. Planted negative: an ON surface whose receipt is deleted turns doctor RED. Add an edge from that check to jev-grzn.

text: Pillar 3 (Honest) promises every quality claim carries an incumbent on the same rows, plus N, date, model id and spend. Its named check, bead-lint, only lints bead structure: WHAT/WHY, a command, a planted negative, a source, dangling deps. jev-6gun checks only that the bar predates the first call. jev-oh7c checks only rows, scorer and seed. No bead checks that an EVAL.md or RECEIPT row has an incumbent arm scored on the same row ids, or that it states N, date, model id and spend. Root AC2 counts 'bead-lint exits 0' as the honest pillar being green.
evidence: ROADMAP.md:26 clause; scripts/bead-lint.py:2-7 docstring and :172-199 (the only rules: no-what, no-why, no-acceptance, no-command, no-negative, no-source, missing-path, placeholder, dangling-dep); var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:97 jev-6gun AC 1-6 (chronology only); var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:424 jev-oh7c (rows/scorer/seed); var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:464 jev-q3q8 AC2 lists bead-lint as the check
fix: Extend jev-6gun (or add a bead) with a receipt-field gate. Every result row must name its incumbent arm and the hash of the shared row-id set, plus N, date, model id and spend. Missing any field means FAIL, not UNVERIFIABLE. Planted negative: an incumbent scored on a different row set FAILs. Make this the honest pillar's check command in mission.toml.

text: Pillar 2's check is the prose 'value ledger receipt per surface', not a command. Root AC2 needs every pillar check to 'exit 0' on 7 daily scoreboard rows, and 2b7f/MP5 executes checks registered by hash, so prose cannot be registered or run. jev-mvvh defines no gate exit semantics: what exit code means pillar green when a row is UNMEASURED or KILL-but-still-on? It also closes after a single --days 7 run. The weekly 'keep, kill or promote each surface' review has no owner: mvvh has no PROMOTE verdict, and nothing schedules it weekly. omp-kit MP2 audits pillar checks; it does not run the ledger.
evidence: .omp/mission.toml:32 `check = "value ledger receipt per surface"`; ROADMAP.md:25 and :47 (weekly keep/kill/promote); var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:464 jev-q3q8 AC2 'exits 0 on 7 consecutive daily rows'; var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:394 jev-mvvh AC2 verdicts 'KEEP / KILL / UNMEASURED' only, closes on one run; var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:32 jev-2b7f (MP2/MP5 run registered checks only)
fix: Give mvvh a gate mode, `python3 work/jev-mvvh/ledger.py --gate --days 7`. It exits 0 only if every ON surface has a KEEP row and every KILL surface is verified OFF; UNMEASURED on an ON surface exits non-zero. Add a PROMOTE verdict (shadow to enforce, gated on a committed bar). Put that command in mission.toml:32. Add a weekly schedule (launchd or MP5) as acceptance.

text: The mission says classifiers 'earn their place in our tools', and 'a family without a host tool' is out of mission. No bead requires a family to name its host tool and consumer. The decision-contract field list (question, state shape, safe_side, budget, label source, bar) has no host-tool or consumer field. uzq1 verdict rows record receipts and backend but no host. Only the dropped .13/.27 were checked for a consumer, by hand. Families like effort, watch, outcome, pin and delegate could reach a verdict with no host hook named.

text: ROADMAP's blast-radius rule says every surface installed outside this repo must have a latency budget under omp's handler limit, never hold the host turn, take its declared safe side, and have a pane-1 off switch. Its '~40% of turns' SWE-bench claim (arXiv:2310.06770) is unsourced to a line.
